name: singlet_harmonization_sample_metadata_ontology_mapping
title: Map sample metadata fields to ontology terms
description: Maps free-text sample field values (tissue, disease, organism, development stage, assay) to one term per field of a pinned ontology release that the target schema allows. Writes the term ID, label, match type, calibrated confidence and a curation flag for each field, and lists unresolved values for curator review. Use it before schema validation of sample metadata. Do not use it for cell type names (use singlet_annotation_cell_ontology_mapping) or for age and sex, which it does not map.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

fields.description: Sample fields to map. Each maps to the ontology named in ontology_release.

target_schema.description: Schema identifier whose allowed ranges give each field's ontology subtree. Required; no default.

ontology_release.description: Pinned release identifier for each ontology used. Required; no default.

UBERON.description: Pinned UBERON release identifier and date.

MONDO.description: Pinned MONDO release identifier and date.

EFO.description: Pinned EFO release identifier and date.

NCBITaxon.description: Pinned NCBITaxon release identifier and date.

HsapDv.description: Pinned HsapDv release identifier and date.

method.description: exact_then_fuzzy is the default dictionary cascade. metasra_graph is the MetaSRA-style typed-graph comparator.

policy.description: Acceptance rules shared by all methods.

abstention_threshold.description: Minimum calibrated posterior to accept a call; below it the value goes to curation.

hierarchy_policy.description: allow_ancestor accepts a broader parent when no exact term exists, and flags it.

allow_obsolete.description: Whether obsolete terms may be emitted. Keep false; obsolete IDs fail validation.

device.description: Execution device. Dictionary methods use cpu; cuda has no effect until an embedding stage is added.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without writing members.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

exact_then_fuzzy.description: Options for exact_then_fuzzy: edit limits by value length.

short_length.description: Values shorter than this many characters use max_edits_short.

max_edits_short.description: Maximum edit distance for values shorter than short_length.

max_edits_long.description: Maximum edit distance for values of short_length or more.

metasra_graph.description: Options for metasra_graph. reference_dir is required with that method.

reference_dir.description: Directory of MetaSRA-style reference synonym sets.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Per field: accepted and abstained pairs and counts by match_type; invalid_ids (must be zero); unresolved value count.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
